posts.text: Since August 2, 2026, everything Claude generates carries two provenance marks: a text watermark and a C2PA credential in image metadata. Neither traces back to you or your account, Anthropic says explicitly, only to the model itself: "made with Claude." Founders relying on this for attribution or leak-tracing should know both marks break easily: paraphrase the text or resave/screenshot the image and the mark is gone.
